description: Best-effort backorder for a name in redemption or pending delete. Holds the first-year price plus a $10 fee from prepaid balance and tries to register it at drop time. Not a guarantee: if we miss it, the full hold (fee included) is released. Premium names and first-year prices over $100 are refused. Cap: 10 open backorders. Test keys (sd_test_) can place a backorder and POST /api/v1/backorders/{id}/simulate {outcome:success|miss}.

api_key.description: Optional. Prefer Authorization: Bearer <key> on the MCP connection.
